'''Noremac''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] within the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]]. Following the end of the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]] in [[3670 BBY]], the [[Jedi Watchman/Legends|Jedi Watchman]] [[Mari-Elan Nora]] was killed by [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] on that world.
